# megapot.build — file manifest

app/layout.tsx — factory document shell + cribble fonts
app/page.tsx — factory landing
app/templates/marketing/page.tsx — iframe preview of the marketing starter
app/go/page.tsx — static /go fallback (no private env)
app/disclaimer/page.tsx — independence + 18+ note
src/components/FactoryLanding.tsx — landing sections
src/components/SiteHeader.tsx — factory nav
src/components/SiteFooter.tsx — public footer (no secrets)
src/lib/play-redirect.ts — MEGAPOT_PLAY_DESTINATION resolver + factory UTMs
src/lib/utm.ts — hostname UTMs for Play / dashboard / /go
src/lib/site.ts — public-safe labels and official Megapot origins
src/styles/cribble.css — cribble tokens (green / ember / ice)
src/styles/factory.css — factory chrome
functions/go.ts — Cloudflare Pages Function for /go
templates/marketing/ — standalone Pages starter (HTML + cribble + /go)
scripts/sync-starter.mjs — copy starter into public/ for preview
scripts/check-privacy.mjs — fail on addresses / invite tokens
